title: Component Registry (v3 sectioned structure)
description: Mirrors RawComponentRegistry (src/types/components.ts): components live in per-category top-level sections, not the pre-v3 unified 'components' map this schema used to describe. Deliberately SHALLOW below the section level: per-entry field vocabularies are enforced by tests/templates/type-json-alignment-stacks-components.test.ts against the TS interfaces, and this schema enforces the structure that actually drifted — the root shape. (The old schema was also unparseable JSON — a trailing comma — so it had never validated anything.)

envVars.description: Keyed env-var definitions; the record key IS the env var name (EnvVarDefinition gains `key` at load via withEnvVarKeys)

selectionGroups.description: Exactly the groups RawComponentRegistry declares and ComponentRegistryManager reads. Four dead groups (stacks/brands/addons/tools) grew here once with no consumer; additionalProperties:false is what stops that recurring.

componentSection.description: Record of component id -> definition. Entries validated shallowly here (name required, everything else per RawComponentDefinition via the alignment tests).
